name: Potion of Restore Health
description: Red as a Vale door. Hearthkeepers brew it from what grows along the Larkbourne; it tastes of cress and warms like a name said kindly.

name: Potion of Restore Stamina
description: Apple-sharp and honey-dark. Chain-bridge runners drink it halfway across, where the wind is worst.

name: Potion of Restore Mana
description: Marsh-marigold gold. Sayers call it breath in a bottle; the Reedfolk call it a mistake to drink standing on a boardwalk.

name: Potion of Fortify Vigour
description: Thick with haw and eel-liver. The heart beats like a mill-wheel for an hour.

name: Potion of Resist Fire
description: Grey-green with a bitter bell-mould nose. The Tolling Order brews it before the ash-winds; you can walk through a burning hedge and only smell of it.

name: Poison of Damage Health
description: Yew-clear and sweet. Applied to a blade, or slipped into a cup by someone who was owed something.

name: Potion of Invisibility
description: A Quiet Hands brew of indigo root and sundew. You do not vanish; you become the kind of thing nobody mentions.

name: Potion of Night Eye
description: Eel-dark. The Gullhithe fishers drink it before the Lamp's beam swings away from the racks.

name: Potion of Fortify Speech
description: Cider-gold with a marigold bloom. Tallymen call it the Charter's cousin: everything you say sounds like it was already agreed.

name: Potion of Cure Poison
description: Cress and apple, sharp enough to make you cough the wrong thing out.

name: Potion of Waterbreathing
description: Marigold and eel. Reedfolk divers use it to visit the drowned and come back.

name: Poison of Slowing
description: Sundew-sticky. Poachers put it on arrows so the hart can be walked down.

name: Potion of Regeneration
description: Hawthorn and bracket fungus, brown as bark. Woodfolk hermits live on this and silence.

name: Potion of Fortify Armour
description: Lichen-grey and gritty. Clan warriors drink it before a blood-price is settled; the skin takes a blow like drystone.

name: Potion of Fortify Stamina
description: Cottongrass and cress. The breath goes deeper for an hour.

name: Poison of Damage Stamina
description: Sundew and foxglove. The Woodfolk's answer to a poacher who runs.

name: Potion of Fortify Sneak
description: Hanging moss steeped with grey-grass. The Quiet Hands drink it and the boards stop creaking, or seem to.

name: Potion of Resist Frost
description: Heather honey and lichen. Clan-runners drink it at Windgate and go up into the snow in their shirts.

name: Poison of Silence
description: Ash-poppy and yew. A drop on the tongue and the Saying will not come; the Circle forbids it and keeps a cellar of it.

name: Potion of Fortify Speed
description: Cottongrass and grey-grass seed. The legs go light; the road goes short.

name: Hearth Flask
description: A horn flask with a wax stopper and a Warden's knot. What is in it is not water: it is the warmth a Hearthstone keeps, and it tastes of whichever hearth you last put your hand to. Three swallows to a filling; the stone fills it again when you rest, and when you come back.
